articles.title: At least 15 killed in Russian strike as Zelenskiy announces more peace talks
articles.summary: A Russian drone strike tragically hit a bus carrying mineworkers in the Ukrainian city of Dnipro, killing 15 people, according to Ukrainian emergency services. The incident, reported on Sunday, underscores the severe human cost and civilian impact of the ongoing conflict. This event highlights the persistent dangers faced by non-combatants amidst escalating hostilities in the region.

articles.title: Budget 2026: It's a timely, textbook case of policy sagacity
articles.summary: Nirmala Sitharaman's 9th successive budget was presented amidst a challenging global macroeconomic and geopolitical climate. The article stresses judging the budget within this complex external policy environment, highlighting how national fiscal decisions are intricately linked to international factors. For SSB aspirants, understanding this interplay is crucial, as economic stability and strategic positioning are interdependent, shaping India's domestic and foreign policy landscape.

articles.title: Union Budget 2026 scraps customs duty on aircraft components, boosting Adani and HAL passenger plane plans
articles.summary: The Indian budget has eliminated basic customs duty on civilian aircraft components, providing a significant boost to domestic passenger plane manufacturing. This move directly supports ambitious plans by both the Adani Group and Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) to produce aircraft within India. This initiative aims to enhance indigenous capabilities and promote self-reliance in the aviation sector, fostering economic growth and reducing import dependency.

articles.title: Box Office: 'Melania' Comes in at No. 3 With $7 Million
articles.summary: A new documentary featuring former US First Lady Melania Trump has been released. The article discusses its commercial viability and whether it will attract her husband's supporters, as she attempts to forge her own public image. This explores the intersection of political figures, public interest, and media ventures beyond traditional political roles, highlighting a prominent international personality's latest endeavor.

articles.title: Everyone is NOT Responsible for Quality
articles.summary: The article discusses a key debate within software development, arguing that software testing should be a distinct professional role rather than merely a task. This perspective often faces opposition from proponents of "True Agile" methodology, who emphasize that quality is a collective responsibility of the entire team, implying no need for dedicated testing roles. It highlights a critical discussion on structuring quality assurance in modern tech projects.

articles.title: Budget: Ashwini Vaishnaw outlines Indias high-speed rail future, semiconductor mission 2.0
articles.summary: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw detailed India's ambitious roadmap, prioritizing next-generation high-speed rail connectivity and a significant push into semiconductor manufacturing. These sectors are deemed critical for national progress and technological self-reliance. This initiative aims to bolster India's infrastructure and industrial capabilities, fostering economic growth and creating future-ready opportunities within the country, highlighting strategic national development.

articles.title: Budget 2026 seen driving cyclical growth, nominal GDP growth pegged at 10% for FY27: Morgan Stanley
articles.summary: A Morgan Stanley report projects that India's Union Budget 2026-27 will bolster cyclical economic growth while simultaneously strengthening the nation's long-term structural foundations. The budget is anticipated to play a crucial role in enhancing India's overall economic resilience and development trajectory, leveraging fiscal policies to achieve sustained progress and stability, according to the analysis.
